title: Sensex tumbles after five-day rally; IT stocks hit hard after Accenture trims full-year revenue outlook
description: From the 30-Sensex firms, Infosys dived over 8%, Tata Consultancy Services tumbled 6%, Tech Mahindra traded 5% lower and HCL Tech declined 4.9%. HDFC Bank and Tata Steel were also among the laggards
